title: DSES: Decision-Sequence Evidence Schema
description: Open specification for cryptographically verifiable human-AI decision evidence. The v0.1 sequence layer proves the order in which a clinician's judgment formed relative to AI exposure via commit-then-reveal sequential disclosure (hash-chained events, RFC 8785 canonicalization, payload commitments with hiding nonces, ed25519 signatures, RFC 9162 inclusion and consistency proofs, external timestamp anchoring). The v0.2 outcome layer adds denominator-closed eligibility manifests, outcome linkage, blinded pre-consensus adjudication under enforceable charters, content-addressed executable rules, recomputable reliance metrics (RAIR, RSR, EAR) with Wilson intervals, and a secondary-use governance layer constraining unit of analysis and individual-level derivation. Every normative requirement is classified by verification class and enforced by release lint, an adversarial regression suite, and a reference verifier.
